## Summary

Describe what changed, why it is needed, and which public workflow or internal
component is affected.

## Validation

List the commands and data used to validate the change. For numerical changes,
include the scientific reference, expected result, and tolerance.

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated focused tests for changed behaviour.
- [ ] I updated user/developer documentation where needed.
- [ ] Ruff and the relevant test suite pass locally.
- [ ] I did not include patient data, identifying metadata, credentials, or
      research data without explicit public-release approval.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this work under the repository's current
      project license.
- [ ] I documented any API break, maturity-level change, or deprecation.
